Neha / Marissa — reviewed with comp modeling. High level guidance:
- Band check: IC3 midpoint in SF is $150k; $160k is within band, $175k would be at the 80th pctile. Finance can approve up to $170k base from recurring headcount budget this FY without additional sign-off. Anything above $170k needs VP approval.
- Signing bonus: $10k is fine; we recommend a clawback window of 6 months for conversions.
- Equity: 0.08% is acceptable but would push total comp above midpoint; Finance prefers mixing a modest equity grant (0.05%) + modest base stretch to top $170k instead of full 0.08%.
- Total-on-cost (salary + benefits + payroll tax) for $170k is ~ $221k annual run-rate (for forecasting).

If Marissa would like to target $175k total base we need VP sign-off and updated hiring memo. For timeline, if you want to stay within delegated authority we should set offer at: $170k base, $10k sign-on, 0.05% equity.

Attaching: proposed_comp_chart.xlsx (tab: finance-recommendation).

Jonas Weber
Director, Finance Planning
Redwood Inference
